name: Humanizer
summary: Agent skill that rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer, without changing what it says.
description: A Markdown skill that removes the tells of AI-generated writing — staged openers, not-X-but-Y contrasts, forced triads, dashes everywhere, inflated claims, stock words, bold labels and filler — while keeping the meaning and matching the writer's voice. It documents 25 patterns drawn from Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' and works with any agent that supports skills. Installs with the Skills CLI, as a Claude Code plugin, or by copying SKILL.md.
